title: Change-Aware Impact Pack Contract
summary: Deterministic, read-only impact reread over one verified published snapshot and the current bounded worktree.

release.compatibility: Shin v1.25 requires an explicit generator-v17 rebuild for corrected authority semantics. No compatibility reader or implicit migration is retained.

inputs.snapshot: impact opens a verified RetrievalSession with a call-scoped shared_existing publication lock. The session owns disk verification or a bound immutable GeneratedSnapshot. Missing index or lock state is not created as a side effect. Its manifest supplies profile-owned source and source-fact paths, content hashes, generator identity, and snapshot_id.
inputs.worktree: observe_worktree enumerates the active profile-owned document and source-fact inputs and compare_worktree compares their metadata, bytes, hashes, and bounded inventory to the snapshot.
inputs.graph: links.jsonl is read from the same published snapshot. Only graph paths that are owned by the snapshot or the observed profile inventory can become impact candidates.
inputs.sourceReread: For eligible current source-fact files, impact rereads bytes only after metadata and content-hash checks and verifies the file again before emission. A concurrent change fails closed.

nativeEvaluation.semantics: Typed bounds and optional bounded in-memory receipt input use the same evaluation as CLI. No argv, file-input adapter, stdout capture or publication in the evaluator. Current source inspection remains explicit read-only I/O. load_source_graph shares row parsing and validation across disk and immutable GeneratedInput cursors; no second graph parser.
nativeEvaluation.diagnosticChange: A missing publication lock now uses index-unavailable/category index instead of the former generic execution-failed. Missing index still exits1, and neither condition creates files. Impact output overflow retains impact-output-too-large.
nativeEvaluation.boundary: Native evaluation does not implement Server storage, remote source observation, producer authentication or complete semantic impact.

freshness.coverageDiagnosis: coverage.unresolved_snapshot_relations is a global count over the published graph; it is not itself an input to evidence_complete. selection_complete concerns selected path coverage. evidence_complete checks the selected reread records: baseline_scope_probe_complete, current_reread_omitted, syntax_observation_complete, relations_omitted and scopes_omitted. Inspect those fields on each reread path to locate what must be reviewed. Neither global graph observations nor complete bounded selection prove complete semantic impact.
freshness.default: Stale snapshot or worktree state is allowed for a bounded review envelope. Freshness is reported in index_current, worktree, changes, and coverage; stale evidence is not relabeled as current.
freshness.requireCurrent: --require-current returns failure when the published snapshot and bounded worktree observation do not establish index_current=true. It does not rebuild or repair the index.
freshness.strict: --strict requires inspection_complete=true: selection_complete must hold and every selected record must also have complete bounded evidence with no required baseline, reread, syntax, scope, or relation omission.
freshness.combined: --require-current --strict requires both freshness and inspection_complete. --strict alone does not turn stale evidence into a currentness failure; it rejects an incomplete inspection.
freshness.profileDrift: Profile configuration drift suppresses all reread evidence and relation traversal and makes selection_complete=false; the output reports profile_configuration_current=false.

limits.overflowPolicy: Limit, depth, evidence bytes, source rereads, relation references, scopes, and serialized output fail or stop selection at their explicit boundary; the command never emits an unbounded replacement.

changeModel.candidateRoots: Every non-empty compare_worktree detail is a depth-zero changed-profile-input. Relations traverse both incoming and outgoing resolved edges breadth-first up to depth when profile configuration is current.
changeModel.ordering: Candidates are ordered by ascending graph depth and then repository-relative path. Relations are retained in deterministic generated-link order and capped per candidate.
changeModel.sourceState: A path is changed when its current content_hash differs from the manifest hash, added or removed when present on only one side, unchanged when hashes match, and unobserved when the current hash is unavailable.
changeModel.scopeCoverage: Scope records are bounded recommendations, not a complete text diff. A changed span is identified by record type, symbol name, and span_hash when that identity is available; an empty span hash cannot prove unchanged behavior.

provenance.snapshot: snapshot_id is copied from the verified published session. Baseline hashes and generated relation rows are historical published-snapshot evidence, not a newly published snapshot.
provenance.worktree: Current hashes and current scope reads are observed-worktree evidence only after bounded reread and stability checks. source_state and index_current remain separate axes.
provenance.relations: Impact relation records expose from, to, kind, line, basis=published-snapshot, source_state, verification_level=declared for document links or verification_level=source-observed for structural source-* relations, and runtime_reachability_proven=false. Relation kind is not an evidence_kind enum.
provenance.scopes: Scope records preserve status, authority_level, evidence_kind, and verification_level from the originating fact or section; declared-document scope retains its originating provenance. range_origin, start_line/end_line, and span_hash remain explicit when present. historical-snapshot and current-published-source basis values remain explicit when current source bytes are not reread.
provenance.tests: tests_to_review is a statically related review list. Every emitted item records execution=not-run and requires_review=true; it is not a test receipt or a pass/fail claim.
provenance.identity: FNV-1a source and span identities are content identities only. They are not cryptographic authenticity, compiler identity, behavioral equivalence, or runtime reachability proof.

output.rereadRecord: Each selected path may expose relations_omitted, current_reread_omitted, syntax_observation_complete, baseline_scope_probe_complete, scopes_omitted, and unlocalized_source_change. Historical fallback sets syntax_observation_complete=false when a prior fact has a *-syntax-incomplete record. Omission counts are per-path bounded evidence, not inferred zeroes.
output.coverage: Reports selection_complete, evidence_complete, inspection_complete, candidate_paths, returned_paths, omitted_paths, evidence_bytes, max_evidence_bytes, byte_budget_constrained, profile_configuration_current, and unresolved_snapshot_relations.
output.evidenceComplete: True only when every selected record reports baseline_scope_probe_complete=true, current_reread_omitted=0, syntax_observation_complete=true where syntax applies, relations_omitted=0, and scopes_omitted=0. It is independent from file freshness.
output.nextActions: All next_actions carry automatic_execution=false. They are review instructions, never a command queue.

sourceRelationBoundary.resolution: Source graph edges with status=resolved and explicit declared document links with status=ok are traversable. unresolved and ambiguous rows remain provenance and omission evidence; they do not become guessed edges.

nonGoals: no compiler call graph, type checking, build graph, or semantic source diff
no claim of complete semantic impact or behavioral equivalence
no runtime reachability, deployment, production, or business-effect proof
no executed test proof, complete test-suite claim, or automatic test execution
no source mutation, generated-index rebuild, repair, publication, or snapshot replacement
no automatic action execution, command queue, session compaction, or compaction-triggered persistence
no Git status, commit, branch, or ignore-file interpretation
no scoring algorithm, query coverage, or retrieval fallback policy change; added facts and finer granularity may change observed candidate counts, ordering, evidence selection, and receipts
documentAmbiguities: A current source file can have a changed file hash while no bounded declaration span is new; the result then reports unlocalized_source_change rather than inventing a member-level cause.
A stale snapshot can still produce a useful bounded review envelope under default mode, but its freshness and omissions must remain visible. Profile drift suppresses all reread evidence.
A related test source is a review recommendation only. Static relation evidence does not establish that the test covers the changed behavior or that it executed.
Ambiguous and unresolved source relations are intentionally fail-closed and can make impact incomplete; no alternative resolver or product-specific interpretation is implied.
